id: \bNice to meet you. My name is Cedric Juniper. I believe you know my daughter.
en: \bNice to meet you. My name is Cedric Juniper. I believe you know my daughter.
it: \bPiacere di conoscerti. Mi chiamo Cedric Aralia. Credo che tu conosca mia figlia.

id: \bI was hoping to get into the cave, but this Krokorok refuses to move. It seems to be waiting for someone.
en: \bI was hoping to get into the cave, but this Krokorok refuses to move. It seems to be waiting for someone.
it: \bSperavo di entrare nella grotta, ma questo Krokorok si rifiuta di spostarsi. Sembra che stia aspettando qualcuno.

id: \rYou just came into my neck of the woods.
en: \rYou just came into my neck of the woods.

id: \rChargestone Cave is up ahead. The place is very electrified.
en: \rChargestone Cave is up ahead. The place is very electrified.
it: \rPiù avanti c'è la Grotta Pietrelettrica. È un posto carico di elettricità.
\bQuesti li ho presi in prestito da mio padre.

id: \bDo you want some advice. You look like you need some improvements.
en: \bDo you want some advice. You look like you need some improvements.
it: \bVuoi un consiglio? Sembra che tu abbia bisogno di qualche miglioramento.

id: \bDon't go in there. A powerful Pokémon dwells there.
en: \bDon't go in there. A powerful Pokémon dwells there.
it: \bNon entrare lì. Ci dimora un Pokémon potente.

id: \bYou thought I was a Trainer? No no, I'm just a traveler. You seem jumpy of people though. Maybe this will calm you down.
en: \bYou thought I was a Trainer? No no, I'm just a traveler. You seem jumpy of people though. Maybe this will calm you down.
it: \bPensavi che fossi un Allenatore? No no, sono solo un viaggiatore. Però sembri piuttosto nervoso con la gente. Forse questo ti calmerà.

id: Krokorok seems like it wants to go with you. Would you like to take it?
en: Krokorok seems like it wants to go with you. Would you like to take it?
it: Sembra che Krokorok voglia venire con te. Vuoi portarlo con te?

id: Krokorok left, heading for the forest.
en: Krokorok left, heading for the forest.
it: Krokorok se n'è andato, diretto verso il bosco.

id: \bYou were supposed to lose that battle.
en: \bYou were supposed to lose that battle.

id: \bCare to help me with a study?
en: \bCare to help me with a study?
it: \bTi va di aiutarmi con uno studio?

id: \bThis will help me out a lot. Thanks again.
en: \bThis will help me out a lot. Thanks again.
it: \bMi sarà di grande aiuto. Grazie ancora.
